title: bryophyllum × houghtonii
intro: Bryophyllum × houghtonii, commonly known as Kalanchoe × houghtonii, is a hybrid succulent plant belonging to the family Crassulaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential to exhibit health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, promoting wound healing and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Bryophyllum × houghtonii include its antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids. Research has identified these bioactive compounds as responsible for its various pharmacological activities, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
